birth.stop: Bucharest, the birth and the two dates
birth.date_confidence: Attested. Romanian Wikipedia gives the archival date plainly, 28 February / 13 March 1907, Old Style and New. Eliade's own Autobiography opens 'M-am nascut la Bucuresti, la 9 martie 1907 (25 februarie stil vechi)', a self-dating four days off the registry that he repeated all his life, so the discrepancy is his rather than the sources'. The birth address is not established: the family bought the Melodiei house only in 1914, so the pin is the quarter and not the room.
